title: GitHub Finder
shortDesc: Search GitHub profiles using GitHub API.
longDesc: Developed a responsive GitHub profile search application using the GitHub REST API. Displays user profile information including avatar, bio, repositories, followers, and following with dynamic error handling.

title: Weather App
longDesc: A dynamic weather dashboard that fetches real-time meteorological data using a third-party API. It provides users with instant access to current temperatures, conditions, and location-based forecasting.

title: Todo-List
shortDesc: Modern todo list application using HTML CSS JS.
longDesc: An interactive task management application built with modern web technologies. Features include task creation, completion toggling, and deletion, ensuring users can efficiently track their daily goals.

title: Portfolio Website
shortDesc: Personal portfolio showcasing my projects and skills.
longDesc: A fully responsive, premium portfolio website built to showcase my technical skills, projects, and resume. Features modern glassmorphism design, theme toggling, and optimized asset delivery.

title: Number-Guessing-Game
shortDesc: A number guessing game with interactive gameplay.
longDesc: A logic-based interactive game where users attempt to guess a randomly generated number. Features instant feedback on high/low guesses, a tracking counter for attempts, and an engaging user interface.

title: E-commerce Website
shortDesc: Responsive e-commerce website with product listings.
longDesc: A front-end e-commerce platform featuring dynamic product listings, category filtering, and a functional shopping cart system. Built with a focus on responsive design for seamless mobile and desktop shopping.

title: Jokes World
shortDesc: A collection of jokes with interactive features.
longDesc: An entertainment application that fetches and displays a collection of random jokes. Built using asynchronous JavaScript and API integrations to provide an infinite stream of interactive content.

title: Quiz App
shortDesc: JavaScript quiz application with score tracking.
longDesc: Built an interactive quiz application featuring timer-based multiple-choice questions. Implemented dynamic question rendering, real-time score calculation, and robust answer validation.

title: Stopwatch Timer
shortDesc: A stopwatch timer application with start, stop, and reset.
longDesc: A precision stopwatch utility built with JavaScript's setInterval functions. Features exact millisecond tracking, lap time recording, and start/pause/reset functionality within a clean interface.

title: Periodic Table
shortDesc: Interactive periodic table with detailed information.
longDesc: An educational tool presenting the complete periodic table of elements. Users can click on individual elements to reveal detailed scientific information, atomic weights, and categorizations.

title: Netflix Card
shortDesc: This Netflix Card Contains some adventures movies.
longDesc: A UI/UX clone component replicating the iconic Netflix media card hover effect. Demonstrates advanced CSS transitions, absolute positioning, and responsive image handling.

title: Pokemon Card
shortDesc: Interactive Pokemon Card with detailed information.
longDesc: A dynamic card generator that fetches data from the PokeAPI. Renders character stats, elemental types, and high-quality sprites inside beautifully styled trading cards.

title: World Atlas
shortDesc: Interactive World Atlas with country descriptions.
longDesc: A comprehensive geographical application that pulls global data via REST API. Users can explore country demographics, flags, capitals, and detailed descriptions in an interactive UI.

title: Currency Converter
shortDesc: Fetches up-to-date foreign exchange rates via REST APIs.
longDesc: A React currency converter is a lightweight web application that calculates real-time exchange rates between different global currencies. Users type an amount, pick source and target units from dropdown menus, and instantly view converted values powered by live API data.
